The regularly scheduled clearinghouse conference for this week will begin at 8:00 a.m. on July 14, 1972, in the Board of Trustees of the Internal Improvement Trust Fund Conference room.
Representatives of the following agencies are requested to attend:

1 - Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services; 2 - Pourd of Trustees of the Internal Improvement Trust Fund; 3 - Department of Community Affairs;

4 - Came and Fresh Mater Fish Commission; 5 - Department of Mealth and Rehabilitative Services - Division of Mealth; 6 - Department of Retural Resources;

7 - Department of Pollution Control; 8 - Department of State - Division of Archives, History and Records Management; and 9 - Department of Transportation.
Topics and projects to be discussed are listed below. To determine whether a project is under review by your agency, note the number by which your agency is designated in the above paragraph.
Department of Transportation - Division of Road Operations: Construction on SR 85, Okaloosa County. SPDC Project No. 72-1255 (Under review by 1,2,3,4,6,7,8)
Department of Transportation - Division of Transportation Planning: DEIS on SR 205, St. Johns County. SPDC Project No. 72-1328. (Under review by 2,4,6,7,8).
U.S. Department of Interior - Bureau of Outdoor Recreation: DEIS pertaining to use of Off-Road Vahicles on Fublic Lands
SPDC Project No. 72-1336. (Under review by 1,2,3,6,7,8,9).
Sincerely yours,
Don L. Spicer
